name: agent-trust-sdk
description: AgenticTrust workspace: @agentic-trust/sdk, @agentic-trust/cli, @agentic-trust/mcp-server, @agentic-trust/next-plugin, @agentic-trust/vercel-plugin, framework middleware, and Next.js starters. Hosted registry: Trustflow Systems.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/next-plugin build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/langchain-middleware build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-ai-middleware build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-plugin build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/next-plugin typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/langchain-middleware typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-ai-middleware typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-plugin typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/next-plugin test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/langchain-middleware test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-ai-middleware test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/vercel-plugin test && node --test scripts/create-starter-prs.test.mjs scripts/submit-ecosystem-prs.test.mjs scripts/notify-verified-domain.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli smoke
